steps.name: dashboard_snippet_hosted_path
steps.detail: dashboard embed snippet should point to /voiceos.js on the same host origin

steps.name: dashboard_prebuild_widget_bundle
steps.detail: dashboard build should invoke the widget build first

steps.name: widget_build_generates_hosted_asset
steps.detail: widget build should generate the browser bundle and sync it to apps/web/public/voiceos.js

steps.name: widget_size_budget_enforced
steps.detail: widget build should enforce the <= 60 KB gzip budget and expose a size check command

steps.name: host_page_uses_browser_bundle
steps.detail: host-page example should reference the generated browser bundle

steps.name: widget_docs_describe_hosted_asset
steps.detail: widget README should document the hosted asset path and size validation command

steps.name: public_directory_present
steps.detail: apps/web/public should exist as the target directory for the hosted widget asset

steps.name: browser_bundle_present
steps.detail: packages/widget/dist/voiceos.js should exist after a successful widget build

steps.name: hosted_asset_present
steps.detail: apps/web/public/voiceos.js should exist after a successful widget build

steps.name: size_artifact_present
steps.detail: packages/widget/dist/size.json should exist after a successful widget build

steps.name: widget_package_declares_esbuild
steps.detail: widget workspace should declare esbuild for the browser bundle step

steps.name: browser_and_hosted_assets_match
steps.detail: dist/voiceos.js and apps/web/public/voiceos.js should be byte-identical

steps.name: size_metadata_matches_bundle
steps.detail: size.json should match the generated bundle bytes and deterministic gzip size

steps.name: bundle_hashes_match
steps.detail: size.json should carry the SHA-256 shared by dist and hosted assets

steps.name: materialized_bundle_within_budget
steps.detail: the materialized browser bundle should stay within the <= 60 KB gzip budget
